Package com.wualabs.qtsurfer.engine.indicators.momentum

package com.wualabs.qtsurfer.engine.indicators.momentum
Momentum and oscillator indicators (free tier).

Contains the free-tier momentum indicators: RSI, MACD, CCI and Stochastic RSI. The paid pro oscillator library (ROC, CMO, Williams %R, Stochastic, Ultimate, …) lives in indicators.momentum.pro in the qtsurfer-engine-indicators-pro module.
